DEFINE MolSingle ::= LIST m, c FROM Bond b has Molecule m AND ALSO has BondType: '-' AND ALSO THE COUNT OF b GROUPED BY m AS c
THE AVERAGE c IN Molecule [has MoleculeLabel: '+'] has MolSingle MolSingleC c

DEFINE SingleAtom ::= LIST a, e FROM Atom a has AtomElement e AND ALSO is of ConnectedAtom has Bond has BondType: '-'
LIST THE COUNT OF Atom [has SingleAtom AtomElement: 'i'], THE COUNT OF Atom [has SingleAtom AtomElement: 's']
THE DISTINCT COUNT OF Atom [has Molecule [is of Bond has BondType: '#']] [has Molecule [is of Atom [has AtomElement e] WHERE e = 'p' OR e = 'br']]

DEFINE Rare ::= LIST e, n FROM Atom a has AtomElement e AND ALSO has Molecule m AND ALSO THE DISTINCT COUNT OF m GROUPED BY e AS n
LIST id, k FROM Atom a has Molecule [has MoleculeLabel: '+'] has MoleculeId id AND ALSO a has AtomElement e AND ALSO e has Rare RareN n WHERE n = 1 AND ALSO a OPTIONALLY is of ConnectedAtom OPTIONALLY has Bond b AND ALSO THE DISTINCT COUNT OF b GROUPED BY id AS k ORDERED WITH id ASCENDING

DEFINE Deg ::= LIST id, k FROM Atom a [has Molecule has MoleculeId: 'TR397'] has AtomId id AND ALSO a OPTIONALLY is of ConnectedAtom OPTIONALLY has Bond b AND ALSO THE DISTINCT COUNT OF b GROUPED BY id AS k
LIST round(THE AVERAGE k IN AtomId has Deg DegK k, 2)

LIST e, c FROM Atom a [is of ConnectedAtom has Bond has BondType: '-'] has AtomElement e BUT NOT [is of ConnectedAtom has Bond has BondType: '='] BUT NOT [is of ConnectedAtom has Bond has BondType: '#'] AND ALSO THE COUNT OF a GROUPED BY e AS c ORDERED WITH e ASCENDING
